reasons.plausibility: The proposed alloy design and strengthening mechanisms align with known principles for refractory high-entropy alloys, though the specific role of chromium could be further clarified.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis includes clear comparison to a baseline (pure tungsten) and defines measurable mechanical and microstructural parameters that can be used to prove or refute the proposed mechanisms.
reasons.usefulness: The approach provides a practical direction for improving refractory alloys for high-temperature applications and outlines specific experiments that will inform future alloy design.
